title: alsine verna var. alpestris
intro: Alsine verna var. alpestris, commonly known as Alpine Wintercress, is a type of flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Alsine verna var. alpestris include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
